changelog:
Initial release of zencreator-video-skill:

- Provides integration with ZenCreator.pro for uncensored NSFW AI photo and video generation.
- Supports image-to-video, video-to-video, and lipsync features using advanced models (Kling, Wan, Seedance Pro).
- Allows high-quality clips up to 1080p and 10 seconds.
- Includes detailed usage instructions for connecting your logged-in Chrome session and interacting with the web app via browser automation.
- Explains credit costs for various generation options and how to get started with free credits.
- Offers example prompts and tool call samples for efficient workflow.
- Notes on uncensored content, privacy, and available upscale options.
summary: Generate uncensored NSFW AI videos from images or videos with ZenCreator.pro, supporting up to 1080p and various advanced animation models.
